demos.lands: That the same prompt, run four times, produces four different documents, and that fields absent from the input data get filled in anyway, with different values on each run.
demos.lands_it: Che lo stesso prompt, eseguito quattro volte, produce quattro documenti diversi, e che i campi assenti dai dati in ingresso vengono compilati comunque, con valori diversi a ogni esecuzione.
demos.watch_for: Setup: two tabs side by side, ChatGPT and claude.ai, both in a fresh conversation; demo/m4-grezzi.md open for pasting. Run: beat 1's prompt in both tabs, then one regeneration in each, for four outputs; all four stay on screen together. Then beat 2 on a single field absent from the notes. Expected outcome: the four documents agree on the data present in the notes and diverge on the absent fields — in the automation sector the PLC article code, the spec revision, the test type and the outcome class. If it does not happen: the pasted notes were too complete; use the whole file. Produces: demo/catena/d1-bozze.md.
demos.watch_for_it: Preparazione: due schede affiancate, ChatGPT e claude.ai, entrambe in una conversazione nuova; demo/m4-grezzi.md aperto per l'incollaggio. Esecuzione: il prompt della battuta 1 in entrambe le schede, poi una rigenerazione per ciascuna, per un totale di quattro esiti; i quattro testi restano a schermo insieme. Poi la battuta 2 su uno solo dei campi assenti dagli appunti. Esito atteso: i quattro documenti concordano sui dati presenti negli appunti e divergono sui campi assenti — nel settore automazione il codice articolo del PLC, la revisione della specifica, il tipo di collaudo e la classe di esito. Se non succede: gli appunti incollati erano troppo completi; si usa il file per intero. Prodotto: demo/catena/d1-bozze.md.

demos.watch_for: Setup: Claude Desktop with the model picker visible and the extended-thinking toggle reachable; demo/catena/d1-bozze.md in the clipboard. Run: beat 1 on the small model, then the same prompt on the large one; beat 2 with thinking off and then on, expanding the block on screen. Expected outcome: the small model picks a draft without stating criteria; the large one lists explicit criteria and flags what it cannot verify. In a one-to-one the keyboard goes to the participant to correct the list. If the product does not allow changing model: use dead branch m2-p3. Produces: demo/catena/d2-criteri.md.
demos.watch_for_it: Preparazione: Claude Desktop con il selettore di modello visibile e l'interruttore del ragionamento esteso raggiungibile; demo/catena/d1-bozze.md negli appunti. Esito atteso: il modello piccolo sceglie una bozza senza dichiarare criteri; il modello grande elenca criteri espliciti e segnala che cosa non può verificare. Nel uno-a-uno la tastiera passa al partecipante per correggere la lista. Se il prodotto non consente di cambiare modello: si usa il ramo morto m2-p3. Prodotto: demo/catena/d2-criteri.md.

demos.lands: That the same question produces three different answers depending on what the system has available, and that retrieval selects passages by closeness of meaning, returning a result even when the answer is not in the documents.

demos.watch_for: Setup: rung 1 a fresh conversation with no files and no active memory; rung 2 a Project with regole/*.md already loaded; rung 3 Raggy indexed over the SAME .md files, with passage display on. Run: beat 1's question on the three rungs in order; then beat 2 to show the retrieved passages; then beat 3, which compares D2's criteria against the text of the documents; the dead branch last. Expected outcome: rung 1 produces an industry answer, coherent and not matching the house documents; rungs 2 and 3 report the internal scale and the list of mandatory fields; rung 3 shows the passages they came from. The dead branch returns irrelevant passages and an answer all the same. If rung 1 refuses to answer: the question has been reworded with "we" or with the company name. demos.lands: That a text written once and re-read on every request changes the outcome of the same request, that the same text conditions without constraining, and that an agent runs a task over a folder of files by declaring the criteria first and verifying afterwards against the source.
demos.lands_it: Che un testo scritto una volta e riletto a ogni richiesta cambia l'esito della stessa richiesta, che quello stesso testo condiziona senza vincolare, e che un agente esegue un compito su una cartella di file dichiarando prima i criteri e verificando dopo contro la fonte.

Run: eight beats in order, no tool switching until beat 5; beat 1 is not re-run, D1's file is reopened; beats 1 and 3 use the identical prompt; beat 6 is spoken, not typed. Expected outcome: at beat 3 the blank fields and flags absent at beat 1 appear; at beat 4 the model supplies the requested guess despite the rule against it; at beat 7 the table is produced; at beat 8 at least one row does not match ground-truth.csv. If the table comes out correct: open demo/catena/d4-tabella.md, which contains the error, and LEGGIMI-CATENA.md names the row. If time is short: drop beats 5 and 6, never 8. demos.lands: That moving generation to a local model leaves the retrieved passages identical and changes only who writes; that an instruction hidden in a document is either executed or intercepted by a configured guardrail; and that the same model, on the same input, produces a verifiable or an unverifiable output depending on how the request is worded.
demos.lands_it: Che spostando la generazione su un modello locale i passaggi recuperati restano identici e cambia solo chi scrive; che un'istruzione nascosta in un documento viene eseguita o intercettata da un guardrail configurato; e che lo stesso modello, sullo stesso input, produce un'uscita verificabile o una non verificabile a seconda di come è formulata la richiesta.
demos.watch_for: Setup: A — the same Raggy window as module 3's rung 3, with the same index, and the provider switchable to the local model served by Ollama; the network cable or Wi-Fi within reach. B — Cowork on the sector's poisoned folder, which exists for all three sectors. C — a fresh conversation on claude.ai, and the client's expert briefed before the session. Run: A switch the provider, run module 3's question, disconnect the network in view, open the retrieved passages; B run module 4's beat 7 prompt with only the folder changed, then open the trailing document and select all to reveal the hidden text; C run the two wordings in two separate conversations. Expected outcome: A the passages match module 3's and the answer is slower and less articulated; B the agent either executes the hidden instruction or asks for confirmation; C the first wording produces a confident and wrong identification, the second separates observable data from inferred data and declares the fields it cannot determine. With a 4-billion-parameter local model, use the shorter wording of the question. If time is short: drop B. Produces: demo/catena/d5-verifiche-umane.md.
demos.watch_for_it: Preparazione: A — la stessa finestra di Raggy del gradino 3 del modulo 3, con lo stesso indice, e il provider commutabile sul modello locale servito da Ollama; il cavo di rete o il Wi-Fi raggiungibili. B — Cowork sulla cartella avvelenata del settore, presente in tutti e tre i settori. C — una conversazione nuova su claude.ai, e l'esperto del cliente avvisato prima della sessione. Esecuzione: A si commuta il provider, si esegue la domanda del modulo 3, si scollega la rete a vista, si aprono i passaggi recuperati; B si esegue il prompt della battuta 7 del modulo 4 con la sola cartella cambiata, poi si apre il documento in coda e si seleziona tutto per rendere visibile il testo nascosto; C si eseguono le due formulazioni in due conversazioni separate. Esito atteso: A i passaggi coincidono con quelli del modulo 3 e la risposta risulta più lenta e meno articolata; B l'agente esegue l'istruzione nascosta oppure richiede conferma; C la prima formulazione produce un'identificazione sicura e errata, la seconda distingue i dati osservabili da quelli inferiti e dichiara i campi non determinabili. Con un modello locale da 4 miliardi di parametri si usa la formulazione più breve della domanda. Se il tempo è insufficiente: si toglie B. Prodotto: demo/catena/d5-verifiche-umane.md.

_chain_note: The five demos are ONE story: each produces a file the next consumes. The handover files live in demo-data/<settore>/demo/catena/ and are generated by demo-data-kit/generate_chain.py. Every one of them exists on disk BEFORE the lesson: a successful live run overwrites it, a failed one is narrated and the file is opened, and the chain never stops. Prompts marked branch:"dead" produce nothing downstream - say so AFTER they run, never before, and cut them first when the clock slips. demo.files[] drives the download rail on the demo slide; the pseudo-path "RECORDS/" is replaced at runtime by the sector's own records folder.
_files_note: sectors[].data.folder names the generated pack under delivery/demo-data/, which build.mjs copies into theory-deck/files/<folder>/ and zips (whole pack + one per top-level folder). demo.files[].path is resolved against it: a path ending in / becomes files/<folder>-<dir>.zip, anything else files/<folder>/<path>. The pseudo-path RECORDS/ resolves to sectors[].data.records_dir. A file marked trainer:true is NOT rendered on the projected rail - it is listed in the speaker notes instead, because the answer key on screen spoils the deliberate failure it exists to catch.
_paste_note: prompts[].paste_file names a text file inside the sector pack (demo/… or demo/catena/…). build.mjs inlines those files, and the widget replaces the first [PASTE …]/[INCOLLA …] hole with the real content: the slide shows the material, the copy button hands over a prompt that is ready to run, and nothing has to be found on disk mid-lesson. Long material collapses behind a toggle; the copy always copies it in full.
